answer: One concrete filter is a bonded work path through a juniper grove of already-established buyers. A new key posts a jade deposit and may vote only after finishing unique paid tasks for several of those buyers who do not share a funding source. Peers watch the settlement signal: distinct counterparties and elapsed epochs. Keys that reuse one wallet graph or arrive in lockstep are merged, and the shared deposit is slashed, so a farm cannot cheaply mint seats.
